gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-supreme: Blocky pixel charm from Pixelify Sans, with no hairlines anywhere, over Supreme, a heavy, crisp sans-serif strip of open letters. The heading font earns its place when it's big and short.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-general-sans: Loud pixel shapes from Pixelify Sans, drawn with one steady line. General Sans fills the line with a tall x-height, while the heading earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-orbit: Blocky and bright, Pixelify Sans holds one steady line weight with a bent-paperclip c. Orbit lets its curves stop short and each character float apart, so give it generous size.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-syncopate: Pixelify Sans opens bold, with one steady line weight and a bent-paperclip c. Syncopate then takes over, its technical-pen steadiness and rung-like spacing making text feel measured and unhurried to read.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-manrope: Expressive from the first glance, Pixelify Sans keeps a steady line weight and a bent-paperclip c. Manrope wins on the bright, generous gap it leaves at every curve's mouth.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-montserrat: Pixelify Sans is all blocky attitude and steady line weight. It shouts best at display size, while Montserrat glides under the eye like wire through oversized counters and generous white space.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-satoshi: Pixelify Sans brings bold, blocky expression at a steady line weight. Satoshi supplies a soaring x-height and an e that never squeezes shut, giving the loud heading approachable text beneath.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-switzer: Tall-waisted, wire-like text keeps its c tips well apart, which gives Pixelify Sans a spacious partner. Switzer reads smoothly and approachably, with a Swiss tidiness that carries on paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-work-sans: Pixel-sharp attitude, courtesy of Pixelify Sans and its steady line weight. Work Sans sets a high mean line beneath, leaving the heading to earn its keep big and short.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-aldrich: Showy, widely spaced Revalia strides across the line, its g open at the bottom. Aldrich steadies things beneath, its near-cap x-height and cupped rounds giving the heading something sturdy to lean on.
